# Rido

> Rido is a shared e-scooter micro-mobility service, live in Torrevieja (Costa Blanca, Spain), with the Costa del Sol to follow. Zero-emission shared e-scooters via the Rido app for iPhone and Android. Operated by Go2 Place S.L.

## About
Rido is a shared micro-mobility company providing e-scooters for rent by the minute via a mobile app, live in Torrevieja on the Costa Blanca. E-bikes are planned for later. Five more towns are planned on the Costa del Sol; those towns will be announced soon. The company is committed to zero-emission transport, swappable batteries, and carbon-neutral operations.

## How It Works
1. Download the Rido app: App Store https://apps.apple.com/app/id6800788222 or Google Play https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ride.rido.app (or https://www.rido.bike/app on a phone)
2. Create your account in the app
3. Find a Rido e-scooter near you on the in-app map
4. Scan the QR code on the handlebar to unlock
5. Ride following traffic rules and bike lanes
6. Park in a designated area shown in the app
7. End the ride and pay only for what you used

## Pricing
Current fares are shown in the Rido app, not on the website. You see the price before every ride. No hidden fees, no minimum top-up, free refund of unused balance.

Plan names only — see the app for amounts:
- **Pay as you go**: No commitment. Ride when you need it.
- **Rido Pass**: Frequent-rider membership. Pricing in the app.
- **Day Pass**: Aimed at visitors who want a full day. Pricing in the app.

## Vehicles
- **Rido Scooter** (e-scooter): 45 km range, 25 km/h top speed, 120 kg weight limit, swappable battery, dual brakes, turn signals, GPS tracking, beginner mode.
- **Rido Bike** (e-bike, coming later): 60 km range, 25 km/h pedal assist, 130 kg weight limit, swappable battery, electric pedal assist, front cargo basket, step-through frame.

## Cities
- Torrevieja, Costa Blanca (Alicante) — live now (e-scooters) — https://www.rido.bike/torrevieja
- 5 towns on the Costa del Sol — coming next, announced soon

## Safety
- Helmet included with every scooter
- One rider per vehicle (tandem detection)
- No riding under the influence (cognitive test at peak hours)
- Park in designated areas only
- Beginner mode available (15 km/h)

## Sustainability
- Zero direct emissions
- Commitment: carbon-neutral operations via verified carbon credits (audited figures published after the first year)
- Swappable and recycled batteries
- Vehicle recycling program at end of life
